projection: Web Mercator EPSG:3857, fitted to SVG viewBox
simplification: ArcGIS maxAllowableOffset 65 metres, coordinate precision 0 metres; rendered at 0.1 SVG-unit precision
notes: Census ZCTAs approximate ZIP delivery areas; they are not official USPS ZIP boundaries.
All 263 inventory ZIPs are accepted for mobile appointment requests; address and availability must be confirmed.
Color differences distinguish adjacent regions and do not encode a measure.
Place labels are city reference points, not precise clinic locations.
